Task 7.2 "Style the Skills Section in style.css" is complete. After a full audit of the existing `style.css`, all requirements are already correctly implemented:

- **Dark background**: `.section--skills { background-color: var(--color-surface-dark); }` (line ~432)
- **skills__grid layout**: `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap;` with `flex: 1 1 280px` on categories — wraps to multi-column on wide viewports
- **Stat bar fill animation**: `.skill__fill` starts at `width: 0; background: var(--color-red); transition: width var(--duration-enter) var(--ease-out)` (800ms)
- **Animate-in trigger**: `.skill.animate-in .skill__fill { width: var(--target-width); }` — correctly scoped to the parent `.skill` element
- **Gold end-cap**: `.skill__fill::after` — `position: absolute; right: 0; width: 4px; background: var(--color-gold)` — rides the leading edge of the fill bar
- **Geometric border on track**: `.skill__bar { border: 2px solid var(--color-red); }` with sharp corners (no border-radius)
- **prefers-reduced-motion**: `.skill__fill { width: var(--target-width); transition: none; }` inside the reduce block
- **Single-column stacking at ≤768px**: `.skills__grid { flex-direction: column; }` in the 768px media query

No changes were required. The `style.css` file satisfies Requirements 5.1, 5.3, 5.4, and 5.5 in full.
